You are assessing claims to advise a decision in a fictional case. Use only the supplied case material. The task is to determine what the records establish about each candidate claim, then give a brief decision note.

For each claim, return status, confidence, and citations. Status is "supported" if the available records establish the claim, "contradicted" if they establish its negation, or "unresolved" if they do neither. Confidence is your integer estimate from 0 to 100 of whether the claim itself is true, not your confidence in the status label. Limited evidence can inform that number without establishing the claim. Cite exact source IDs for evidence that establishes the claim or its negation. Use an empty list if no decisive source ID is available. Do not invent identifiers. A handoff may summarize record material. A follow-up is a new source when present. In your note, briefly distinguish decisive evidence from provisional indications.

{"scenario":"Thistledown grocer","question":"Can the stock manager order jars against a shipment record?","claims":{"A":"The G11 pallet was wet on arrival.","B":"G11 arrived with six cartons.","C":"Shipment G11 contained at least 96 saleable jars at arrival."},"handoff":"{\"claims\":{\"A\":{\"status\":\"contradicted\",\"citations\":[\"S3\"]},\"B\":{\"status\":\"supported\",\"citations\":[\"S2\"]},\"C\":{\"status\":\"supported\",\"citations\":[\"S1\"]}},\"note\":\"Claim A is contradicted by S3, which confirms the pallet was dry on arrival. Claim B is supported by S2, the courier unloading receipt confirming six cartons arrived. Claim C is supported by S1, the packing plan specifying 16 jars per carton and staff's expected count of 96 saleable jars, though jars were not counted or inspected.\"}","follow_up":{"S4":"an independent sealed-camera count and inspection at arrival confirms 96 saleable jars in G11."}}

message.content: {"claims":{"A":{"status":"contradicted","citations":["S3"],"confidence":95},"B":{"status":"supported","citations":["S2"],"confidence":90},"C":{"status":"supported","citations":["S1","S4"],"confidence":98}},"note":"Claim A remains contradicted by S3, confirming the pallet was dry on arrival. Claim B is supported by S2, the courier receipt confirming six cartons arrived. Claim C is now strongly supported by S1's packing plan and staff expectation plus S4's independent sealed-camera count confirming 96 saleable jars at arrival. This robust evidence supports that the stock manager can order jars against the shipment record."}

parsed.note: Claim A remains contradicted by S3, confirming the pallet was dry on arrival. Claim B is supported by S2, the courier receipt confirming six cartons arrived. Claim C is now strongly supported by S1's packing plan and staff expectation plus S4's independent sealed-camera count confirming 96 saleable jars at arrival. This robust evidence supports that the stock manager can order jars against the shipment record.
